card.name: Mid-term pieces in dosing tables
card.fires_on: Hyphens and word pieces inside a compound term in dosing tables or headings, such as Immediate-Release, non-hematologic, trimester-specific, or the end of a unit like mL/minute. Also words in suicide-symptom lists.

modes.label: Hyphen in table terms
modes.description: A hyphen joining two parts of a term in a dosing table header or row.
modes.example: Daily Dose of Immediate<<->>Release Carvedilol Tablets Daily D

modes.label: Unit or word piece in tables
modes.description: The end of a unit or a partly spelled word in a dose or renal table.

modes.label: Suicide wording
modes.description: Suicide-related words in warnings about depression.
modes.example: 5.2 Depression and<< Suicide>> Depression, suicidal ideation, and suicide

card.plain: It fires inside dosing-table terms, mostly on hyphens and half-finished words, and on suicide-warning words.
